summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term indices, evidenced by massive call buying in SPX and NDX with extremely low Put/Call ratios (SPXW 0.24, NDX 0.17). Significant directional conviction is seen in the accumulation of SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes for 2026 and 2027, totaling billions in premium, alongside heavy NDX 24100C activity. Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in the SPX 6000C (exp 2026-04-17 and 2026-06-18) and SPX 7000C (exp 2026-06-18), signaling a sustained long-term upward bet. Traders should monitor for continued strength in semiconductor names like AMD and NVDA, which show heavy call dominance, and watch if the SPX 7000P accumulation ($408.8M) signals a long-term tail-risk hedge against the massive call buying.
